eyebrow.zh: 本地 · 单命令 · 提速 3 倍

headline.zh:
大模型本地跑得慢？
提前把下一步要用的专家读进内存，推理快 3 倍
headline.en:
Huge models crawling on local hardware?
Pre-stage the experts you'll fire next into memory — 3× faster decode

sub.zh: 读出模型路由器下一步要触发哪些专家，提前让系统把它们从固态硬盘读进内存——不等缓存慢慢热起来。
sub.en: It reads which experts the router fires next and tells your OS to read those weights from SSD into memory ahead of time — no more waiting for the cache to warm.

body.zh: 超稀疏大模型的推理在本地只有约 4 t/s——权重文件太大塞不进显存，只能边跑边从硬盘现读。提前把下一步要用的专家读进内存，解码提到约 12 t/s。
body.en: Ultra-sparse models crawl at ~4 t/s locally — the weights won't fit in VRAM, so the engine reads them from disk on demand. Pre-stage the experts you'll fire next into memory and decode hits ~12 t/s.

title.zh: 不等路由触发，先猜中下一步
title.en: Predicts the next fire before it happens

body.zh: 主流引擎都是在路由触发之后才去硬盘现读权重——慢就慢在这。xpref 读路由器正在算的专家分布，提前预测下一个会触发的专家，在触发前就让系统把权重读好。
body.en: Stock engines page weights from disk only after the router fires — that's the slowdown. xpref reads the expert distribution the router is computing, predicts the next-firing experts, and has the OS read their weights before the fire.

title.zh: 一条命令，30 秒看到结果

body.zh: 装完直接跑：内置一条真实模型的采样轨迹，不用先编译引擎就能看到预测命中率和提速投影。真要复现完整 4→12 t/s，再打一个补丁、重建一次引擎即可。
body.en: Install and run: a real sample trace is bundled, so you see recall and projected speedup without building an engine first. To reproduce the full 4→12 t/s, apply one patch and rebuild once.

chips: › uv tool install 一行装好

title.en: Zero ops, runs on one machine

body.zh: 不用搭微服务、不用配集群：一个命令行工具做预测和预取，加一个一次性的引擎补丁导出路由分布。MIT 开源，两个进程、一个内存映射的检查点文件。
body.en: No microservices, no clusters: a CLI that predicts and prefetches, plus a one-time engine patch to export the router distribution. MIT-licensed — two processes and one memory-mapped checkpoint.

headline.zh: 本地把超大模型跑起来

sub.zh: 一条命令装好，30 秒看到提速投影。
sub.en: Install in one command, see the speedup projection in 30 seconds.

tag.zh: 预测下一步要触发的专家，提前读进内存。MIT 开源。
tag.en: Predicts the next-firing experts, pre-stages them into memory. MIT-licensed.
